messages:
Maria Gomez: Heads up: APAC gpu-pool-7 (node gpu-aps7-112) showing a sustained ECC correctable spike since 2026-03-18 08:12 UTC. Card 5 producing ~1400 correctables/day, Xid 61 counts creeping up. Seen by autoscaler?

sre-bot: Alert: ECC_CORRECTABLE_RATE high on gpu-aps7-112: card5=1402/day; rolling window 30m rate=220/hr. Severity: warn.

Ashok Patel: Thanks. Can you dump /var/log/nv_error_log and the last 6 kernel oops? Also what's the job mix on that node (inference vs training)?

Maria Gomez: Attached short log paste: ```Mar 18 08:10 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 61, 0x00000000``` Mostly inference pods, 8 clients. No long-lived training.

Jamie Lee: @Ashok we probably need an operational policy instead of a manual runbook here. Proposal: phased dampening -> soft-quarantine -> hard-evac. Soft-quarantine moves new allocations away but leaves running pods; hard-evac drains. Thoughts?

Ashok Patel: Agree. My thresholds proposal: dampening window = 2h moving avg > 600/day on a card triggers 'dampening' (tag as noisy); if 3 consecutive 30m windows > 200/hr -> soft-quarantine; if total correctables > 5000 or any UNCORRECTABLE -> hard-evac and replace. Add 30m hysteresis to avoid flapping.

Tori Nguyen: We should make the policy capacity-aware. APAC is tight this week; soft-quarantine should prefer routing to eu-west burst pool or dedicated spot GPUs, not automatically trigger hard-evac unless risk.

Dan O'Neill: Operational knobs: a) label node: node.k8s.io/gpu-noisy=true b) route scheduler to avoid node for new pods c) set eviction priority low for short-lived inference. Also add metric 'noisy_card_reason' to tickets.

Jamie Lee: Can we do a canary rollout of the policy in one APAC zone first? Also add an override for VIP customers so we don't silently move critical jobs.

Ashok Patel: Implementation notes: controller will watch per-card counters from telemetry (NVML per-GPU ECC counters), maintain sliding windows. Pseudocode: ```if sliding_avg(2h)>600: label node 'gpu.noisy.dampened' elif consecutive_30m_windows>=3: annotate node 'gpu.quarantine.soft' && cordon new pods elif total>5000 or uncorrectable: drain --ignore-daemonsets && replace```

Maria Gomez: Risk: false positives during large bursty load (model uploads, long prompt loops). Suggest we suppress for pods with annotation 'gpu.allow-noise=true' and for continuous training.

Tori Nguyen: Add costs note: replacement is expensive (RMA and node reprovision) and impacts warm cache. Prefer 'graded dampening' for 48h before replacement. Also we should auto-schedule a replacement only if median corrected errors per-token stays above threshold.

Dan O'Neill: Ops checklist: alerts, runbook, k8s operator, ticket auto-creation to hw-team, spare-card inventory check. Who can draft the playbook?

Maria Gomez: I'll draft a playbook PR with thresholds, a sample alert rule, and a canary rollout plan. Target PR by EOD today. @Ashok can you take the operator changes?

Ashok Patel: On it. I'll spin a branch with controller logic and unit tests. Will also add metrics and a dashboard tile.

Jamie Lee: :thumbsup: Let's coordinate a 10% canary in APAC, monitor SLO impact for 24h, then expand. If we see false triggers, reduce sensitivity.
